objective_semantics: L/L0 for wl; 0.5*L/L0 + 0.5*T/T0 for joint; frozen common D reference WL routing normalizers
timing_semantics: sum over direction-known original nets of risk_nets.weight * maximum driver-to-sink interconnect delay in ns; per-layer Manhattan delay plus directed CHANZ delay and terminal_delay_ns; one portal per cross net; criticality is pre-placement unit-depth proxy, NOT STA
criticality_semantics: pre-placement unit-delay topological-depth proxy, NOT measured VPR timing
portal_semantics: one actual directed-access-compatible portal per net; region reachability upper bound, not pin-route certificate
candidate_rule: common frozen D incident-WL priority and original-D trust box; single 3x3 grid plus up to eight opposite-layer partners
move_budget_semantics: max_moves is accepted node touches; single=1, atomic exchange=2
